## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Boundary Code**: This addon is a complete feature module for recruitment pipeline management. It extends hr (Employee, Department, Company) with recruitment-specific entities and workflows.
- **Applicant & Job Domain**: The core concepts are hr.applicant (candidate application) and hr.job (job posting). hr.recruitment.stage models the Kanban pipeline. Email, interviews, and offers are derived workflows.
- **Integration Points**: Calendar (interview scheduling), UTM (job posting campaign tracking), attachment_indexation (resume search), digest (recruiter email summaries).
- **Belongs With**: hr_contract, hr_employee for end-to-end hire-to-payroll pipelines; shares Employee and Department models with hr core.
